config.clock: Readiness outside turn clock. Projection, sampling, IPC, native search, host deadline and process reap inside. No concurrent searches by this script. Other applications/scheduling are not controlled.
config.information: Moving player filtered view only; dark captures known solely to captor; referee setup seed/real allocation not passed to engines.
config.comparison: Focused results contain exact full-window scores for identical samples at one nominal depth, at least2 roots unless only1 legal root. Other shallow scores schedule exploration only.
